comment: Metrics the SDKs define but docs/references/sdk-metrics.mdx does not document. bin/check-metrics-against-sdks.js reports anything not listed here, so this file is the record of what we have decided not to document. An empty note means the entry has not been reviewed yet; fill it in or document the metric and remove the entry. Regenerate with: yarn check:metrics:sdks --update-baseline

undocumented.name: activity_canceled
undocumented.note: Deprecated in the SDK. Superseded by activity_execution_cancelled.

undocumented.name: local_activity_canceled
undocumented.note: Deprecated in both SDKs. Superseded by local_activity_execution_cancelled.

undocumented.name: local_activity_failed
undocumented.note: Deprecated in both SDKs. Superseded by local_activity_execution_failed.

undocumented.name: workflow_task_no_completion
undocumented.note: Go declares WorkflowTaskNoCompletionCounter but never references it, so it is Java only.
